title: Interactive HR Diagram Lab
description: Gaia-style Hertzsprung-Russell diagram lab for colour-magnitude structure, stellar populations and evolution tracks.
equations: Absolute magnitude M = m - 5 log10(d/10 pc)
Luminosity-temperature-radius scaling L = 4 pi R^2 sigma T^4
references: Gaia Collaboration, 2023. Gaia Data Release 3: Summary of the content and survey properties. Astronomy & Astrophysics, 674, A1.
